events.summary: 味全龍奪下2026年中職總冠軍，於11月22日舉行封王遊行。台北市長蔣萬安登車祝賀。奪冠後傳出總教練葉君璋恐交出兵符，領隊丁仲緯表示教練團仍在討論，但葉君璋一定會留在團隊中。球員郭天信則坦言對卸任傳聞感到不捨但尊重球團。

events.title: Carlos Alcaraz擊敗球王Alexander Zverev首奪ATP年終賽冠軍
events.special_reason: 網壇頂級賽事決賽與重大冠軍得主誕生
events.why_matters: 網球年度收官大賽的最高榮譽之爭
events.summary: 西班牙好手Carlos Alcaraz在ATP年終賽決賽以6比2、7比6（9比7）擊敗世界球王Alexander Zverev，拿下生涯首座年終賽冠軍。23歲的Alcaraz寫下近期14連勝，並成為奪得四大滿貫與年終賽冠軍的最年輕選手。自8月美網復出後的84天內，他取得21勝1敗，於參加的5項賽事中席捲4冠。
events.note: 來源一致確認Alcaraz直落二奪得年終賽冠軍。
events.context:
【BBC Sport】Image source, Getty Images Image caption, Carlos Alcaraz won the ATP Finals for the first time on his fourth appearance at the season-ending tournament Carlos Alcaraz outplayed world number one Alexander Zverev to end his wait for a first ATP Finals title and complete a remarkable post-injury return to the sport. A season which began with Alcaraz becoming the youngest man to complete the career Grand Slam, before he was ruled out for more than four months with a wrist issue, ended with the Spaniard holding aloft another of the sport's biggest trophies. Alcaraz, still wearing heavy strapping around his upper-left leg following his injury scare earlier in the week, collapsed to the ground in celebration after sealing a 6-2 7-6 (9-7) win in a dramatic second-set tie-break. It was a statement victory over Zverev, who took advantage of Alcaraz and Jannik Sinner's injury absences to rise to the top of the rankings and claim his first two major titles. It was a 14th successive win and a third-straight title triumph for seven-time major winner Alcaraz, who demonstrated beyond any doubt that he is back to his devastating best. "Lifting this trophy is something I have been chasing for a really long time, it means the world to me," the 23-year-old said. "I have been through really difficult moments with myself, with my team. For me it's been an amazing week. "I couldn't finish the week in a better way." It is just 84 days since Alcaraz made his return at the US Open in August after a lengthy spell on the sidelines. Since that tournament, the current world number three has won 21 of his 22 matches and swept titles at four of the five tournaments he has entered. With his latest victory, Alcaraz has become the youngest man to win all four Grand Slams and the season-ending Finals - and only the fourth in history. Zverev, who ends 2026 with an ATP Tour-leading 69 match victories, had not dropped serve in four straight-set matches to reach the final. But for much of the two-hour title decider, his greatest weapon was dismantled by a brilliant Alcaraz. Alcaraz handled the occasion far better as he emerged from a tense start with a 4-1 double-break lead on his way to the first set. Image source, Getty Images Image caption, Carlos Alcaraz won the ATP Finals for the first time on his fourth appearance at the season-ending tournament The contrasting emotions of the two players were evident when Alcaraz wore a big grin after pulling off a between-the-legs lob that Zverev smashed

events.special_reason: 摩托車賽事最高殿堂的平紀錄世界冠軍
events.why_matters: 頂級賽車運動的歷史紀錄追平時刻
events.summary: 33歲西班牙名將Marc Marquez在葡萄牙大獎賽以第8名完賽，成功達到前9名的門檻，奪得個人第8座MotoGP世界冠軍，追平傳奇車手Giacomo Agostini保持的紀錄。該站冠軍由Marco Bezzecchi奪得。Marquez本季代表杜卡迪車隊拿下7場正賽冠軍與10場衝刺賽勝利，這也是他各級別合計第10座世界冠軍。

events.context:
【BBC Sport】Image source, Getty Images Image caption, This was Marquez's second MotoGP title with Ducati, after six riding for Honda Marc Marquez clinched a record-equalling eighth MotoGP championship with an eighth-placed finish in the Portuguese Grand Prix on Sunday. The Spaniard needed to finish in the top nine on his Ducati to seal a second consecutive championship and move level with legendary Italian Giacomo Agostini on eight titles. He started second on the grid and rode cautiously after crashing out in the sprint race on Saturday. Aprilia's Italian rider Marco Bezzecchi, who held a 102-point advantage over Marquez at one stage this season, was Sunday's race winner, while Marquez's fellow Spaniards Jorge Martin and Raul Fernandez completed the top three. But the attention was all centred around Marquez, who was hoisted in the air by his team after crossing the line. The 33-year-old won seven grands prix and 10 sprint races this season, adding to the 11 grands prix he won in 2025. While Sunday marked his eighth MotoGP title, it was Marquez's 10th championship overall after wins in the 125cc and Moto2 categories on his journey to the top. Image source, Getty Images Image caption, Marquez became the youngest MotoGP champion in his debut season in 2013
